title: Battery Type Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and battery selection
description: An interactive six-column infographic comparing coin, AAA, AA, 18650 lithium-ion, 9V, and D batteries.

educational.topic: Battery chemistry, voltage, capacity, and applications
learningObjectives: Compare the nominal voltage, typical capacity, chemistry, and common use of six battery types.

keyQuestions: How can batteries with the same voltage have very different capacities?
Which battery chemistry and package best fit a particular project?
commonMisconceptions: A physically larger battery must have a higher voltage.
An 18650 lithium-ion cell is the same format as a lithium-polymer pouch cell.
